All of the groomers have all been absolutely great with my little girl, Clementine. I have a bit more of a drive going to the Westchester location, but the cleanliness of the store, the attitude and friendliness of the sales and grooming staff, outshine any other Petco I have shopped. Jessica is still Clementine's favorite groomer!! Clementine jumps for joy at the mention of going Petco to see Jessica.

Jessica always does a wonderful job with our anxious pup even though he hates nail trims (and brushing, and baths...). She is so patient and has 10+ years of experience so your baby is in good hands! On top of that, all of the staff in this Petco are super friendly and helpful. We highly recommend training sessions with Rachel.
I find Demareo an excellent groomer. He listens to my concerns and addresses them and my dog looks great after her visit.

Not sure if I received all of the services that were discussed before my appointment with Cedric. We discussed the desired length but both pups were cut much lower than expected. It did not appear asthough the nails were cut on either pup? Dunno they were left much longer than expected. Cedric called to discuss matting of one of my pups and I was expecting the lower cut  and ears✂️ on that one. Otherwise it was fine! The total price was higher than discussed because I declined any extras. Should have been two full cut and baths!
Westchester PETCO pet-stylist team is amazing! Highly recommend them!
Jessica is a gem! She treats my Bella with tender loving care! Excellent customer service!

The groomers seem to stay for a while at this store, and I like having a "regular groomer" for each dog.  They know what they are doing, and the prices are reasonable--especially with a membership.  Everyone has been upbeat and friendly, too.
As always, Jessica is fantastic. She knows what length I like my dog's hair to be cut to, and she treats my pet like she was her own.

For a good experience, avoid this place. Average work, and once clipped my dog and gave him weird haircut around the face and tail, which the stylist admitted to. Worse a few times they power tripped me about taking or not taking your appointment or walk-ins. Suspect it's to do with the employees wanting to minimize their workloads. Luckily there are other branches around here.

I left my grandpup for grooming and got a call an hour later informing me that his tail was too matted for them to finish because they couldn’t shampoo it. They apparently don’t have sharp enough razors so I was advised to take him to a vet. I picked him up and took him to Eco Pet (a family owned groomer) on La Tijera and they dematted his tail and groomed him without issue. The Petco groomers were lovely and were only following company policy to avoid liability. The policy unfortunately wasted my time.
These stars are for Jessica!!! We go to her every month and my 100lb baby comes back to me so fresh & so clean!!!
The petco staff did an excellent job cutting my dog's hair. This is first time my dog got the hair cut, and I love it
I’m very happy with the way they groomed my pet it’s a pleasant and easy process for me and my dog thank you petco team

I have two pugs who are my babies! I don’t trust them with most people but whenever I take them to Petco Grooming I know they are in the best hands! I never worry about them for a minute! My two dogs have bonded with Chanel and Damareo. I never see them get so excited to see anyone more than them! They always come home all fresh, clean, and happy! Chanel and Damareo are all around amazing! My dogs (and I) truly do love them! I am so lucky to have two amazing people I can trust my little guys with! Wouldn’t go anywhere!!!
I used the the self-serve dog wash for my two pups. I went on a Saturday and staff were super friendly. The place was busy and they knew how to maintain the flow. Great work!
Chanel is the best! She takes great care of the pets and gets them looking and feeling great!

My experience is always exceptional.  Jessica and Channel are part of my family.  The dogs had to get their vaccinations so it has been over a month since their last grooming.  Boy when they saw Jessica and Chanel there were tons of hugs and kisses.  They made the dogs feel so welcomed. I love them for it!
